strings.rules_intro: Each library entry lists 2–3 possible interpretations, each tagged as interest, conditional, mismatch, polite pass or logistics/noise. These rules move them up or down; ties keep the editorial order.
strings.rule_R1: A specific date or meeting was offered → genuine-interest and conditional readings move up; polite-pass moves down.
strings.rule_R2: They requested specific materials → interest/conditional readings move up.
strings.rule_R3: They brought in another partner from their own fund → process/interest readings move up.
strings.rule_R4: They suggested a different fund → fit/mandate mismatch moves up.
strings.rule_R5: No next step at all → polite-pass reading moves up.
strings.rule_R6: Only a vague next step (“keep us posted”) → conditional and polite-pass readings move up slightly.
strings.rule_R7: More than three weeks with no concrete next step → polite-pass moves up.
strings.rule_R8: A promised date has passed → stalled-process/bandwidth and polite-pass readings move up.
strings.rule_R9: Less than a week has passed → too soon to read much into timing; logistics readings move up slightly.
strings.rule_R10: Pre-seed + “too early”/“traction” → many funds start later, so stage mismatch moves up slightly.
